title.zh: OpenAI drops another batch of mathematical breakthroughs
title.en: OpenAI drops another batch of mathematical breakthroughs

current_state.zh: OpenAI released a batch of 722 manuscripts spanning 372 result families containing solutions to long-standing mathematics problems generated by an unreleased frontier model, continuing a run of AI-driven math breakthroughs that has stirred debate over research ethics.
